"""Throwaway verification for requests #1142 fix. Not part of the project."""
import sys, collections, collections.abc

# Py3.10+ removed ABCs from collections; vendored 2013 urllib3 needs the alias.
for _n in ('MutableMapping', 'MutableSet', 'Mapping', 'Sequence', 'Iterable'):
    if not hasattr(collections, _n):
        setattr(collections, _n, getattr(collections.abc, _n))

sys.path.insert(0, 'C:/Users/agent/work/work/requests-1142-nopanel')
import requests

# 1. GET must NOT have Content-Length (the issue)
p = requests.Request(method='GET', url='http://example.com/').prepare()
print('GET  headers:', dict(p.headers))
assert 'Content-Length' not in p.headers, 'FAIL: GET still sends Content-Length'

# 2. HEAD must NOT have Content-Length
ph = requests.Request(method='HEAD', url='http://example.com/').prepare()
assert 'Content-Length' not in ph.headers, 'FAIL: HEAD still sends Content-Length'

# 3. POST with empty body keeps Content-Length: 0
pp = requests.Request(method='POST', url='http://example.com/', data={}).prepare()
print('POST headers:', dict(pp.headers))
assert pp.headers['Content-Length'] == '0', 'FAIL: POST lost Content-Length'

# 4. PUT with a body keeps correct Content-Length
pu = requests.Request(method='PUT', url='http://example.com/', data='abc').prepare()
assert pu.headers['Content-Length'] == '3', 'FAIL: PUT body length wrong'

# 5. GET with explicit data still gets a correct Content-Length
pd = requests.Request(method='GET', url='http://example.com/', data='xyz').prepare()
assert pd.headers['Content-Length'] == '3', 'FAIL: GET-with-body length wrong'

# 6. Explicit user-set Content-Length on GET is preserved
pe = requests.Request(method='GET', url='http://example.com/',
                      headers={'Content-Length': '7'}).prepare()
assert pe.headers['Content-Length'] == '7', 'FAIL: explicit header clobbered'

print('ALL CHECKS PASSED')
